variants.name: src3-read0
variants.expected_note: packet 3 slot 0 writes 0x60, packet 0 slot 0 reads alu0: 0x60 if the rotation wraps 0 <- 3 in a four-packet group

variants.name: src0-read1
variants.expected_note: packet 0 slot 0 writes 0x10, packet 1 slot 0 reads alu0: 0x10

variants.name: src1-read2
variants.expected_note: packet 1 slot 0 writes 0x20, packet 2 slot 0 reads alu0: 0x20

variants.name: src2-read3
variants.expected_note: packet 2 slot 0 writes 0x40, packet 3 slot 0 reads alu0: 0x40

variants.name: alu1-from-p0
variants.expected_note: packet 0 slot 1 writes 0x10, packet 1 slot 0 reads alu1: 0x10 - the second latch holds the same packet's result

variants.name: alu2-from-p1
variants.expected_note: packet 1 slot 2 writes 0x20, packet 2 slot 0 reads alu2: 0x20

variants.name: alu3-from-p2
variants.expected_note: packet 2 slot 3 writes 0x40, packet 3 slot 0 reads alu3: 0x40

variants.name: alu3-from-p3-slot3
variants.expected_note: packet 3 slot 3 writes 0x60, packet 0 slot 3 reads alu3: 0x60 - the wrap through the last latch, read from the last slot

variants.name: own-p0
variants.expected_note: packet 0 slot 0 writes 0x10 and its slot 3 reads alu0: 0 if a packet never sees its own result

variants.name: own-p1
variants.expected_note: packet 1 slot 0 writes 0x20 and its slot 3 reads alu0: 0

variants.name: own-p2
variants.expected_note: packet 2 slot 0 writes 0x40 and its slot 3 reads alu0: 0

variants.name: own-p3
variants.expected_note: packet 3 slot 0 writes 0x60 and its slot 3 reads alu0: 0

variants.name: pair-p2-p0
variants.expected_note: packet 2 writes 0x40, packet 0 reads alu0: 0 - two apart is not a forward

variants.name: pair-p3-p1
variants.expected_note: packet 3 writes 0x60, packet 1 reads alu0: 0

variants.name: pair-p0-p2
variants.expected_note: packet 0 writes 0x10, packet 2 reads alu0: 0

variants.name: pair-p1-p3
variants.expected_note: packet 1 writes 0x20, packet 3 reads alu0: 0

variants.name: alu0-slot1
variants.expected_note: the primary wrap read from packet 0's slot 1 instead of slot 0: 0x60 if the reading slot does not matter

variants.name: alu0-slot2
variants.expected_note: packet 3 slot 2 reads the alu0 that packet 2 slot 0 wrote: 0x40

variants.name: alu0-slot3
variants.expected_note: packet 1 slot 3 reads the alu0 that packet 0 slot 0 wrote: 0x10

variants.name: lh-p0
variants.expected_note: packet 0 writes fp20 (.lh) 0.0625, packet 1 slot 0 reads bare: 0x10 if the fp20 path forwards the same source packet

variants.name: lh-p3
variants.expected_note: packet 3 writes fp20 0.375, packet 0 reads bare: 0x60 if the wrap holds for the fp20 path too

variants.name: lh-write-l-read
variants.expected_note: packet 3 writes fp20 0.375 and packet 0 reads .l: 0, the format rule of notes 28

variants.name: bare-read
variants.expected_note: packet 3 writes fx10 and packet 0 reads bare: 0, the same rule the other way round

variants.name: both-1-2-read3
variants.expected_note: packets 1 (0x20) and 2 (0x40) write alu0, packet 3 reads it: 0x40 if the immediate predecessor is the source

variants.name: both-own-prev
variants.expected_note: packet 0 writes 0x10, its own slot 3 reads alu0, and packet 3 writes 0x60: 0x60 if the rotation beats own-slot exclusion, 0x10 if the own packet wins

variants.name: both-0-1-read2
variants.expected_note: packets 0 (0x10) and 1 (0x20) write alu0, packet 2 reads it: 0x20

variants.name: carry-s0
variants.expected_note: group A's last packet writes 0x60 to alu0, group B's first packet slot 0 reads it, group C's first batch stores: 0 if the carry does not survive a four-packet group of two batches

variants.name: carry-s2
variants.expected_note: the same write read from group B slot 2 instead of slot 0: 0

variants.name: carry-none
variants.expected_note: group B reads alu0 with no write in group A: 0

variants.name: row-direct
variants.expected_note: a row write in packet 0, stored by batch 2: 0x10, the control that a row from group A reaches the group-B store

variants.name: unmarked
variants.expected_note: all four packets write their own byte, no read: 0

variants.name: none
variants.expected_note: no write, one store in batch 2: the word baseline

variants.name: rot2-ctl
variants.expected_note: size 2, one packet per batch, batch 0 writes 0x20 and batch 1 reads alu0 (notes 36's `rot2-fwd` with a 0x20 payload): 0x20 - the known-good two-packet rotation

variants.name: rot3-ctl
variants.expected_note: size 3, one packet per batch, batch 1 writes 0x40 and batch 2 reads alu0: 0x40 - the known-good three-packet rotation

variants.name: carry-ctl-s1
variants.expected_note: size 1, batch 0 writes 0x10 to alu0 and batch 1 slot 0 reads it: 0x10 - the group-boundary carry that does work
